Implement exact provider-scoped cancellation (#168)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-44
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add one provider-neutral cancellation identity and the `Confirmed`, `Requested`, `AlreadyTerminal`, `Unsupported`, and `OutcomeUnknown` outcomes with bounded evidence
    - fail closed on missing, stale, or conflicting retained identity before provider I/O
    - interrupt only the exact Codex turn and cancel only exact Grok or Cursor dispatch/session/prompt targets
    - keep cancellation deadlines observational so they never stop shared runtimes or provider processes
    - add focused provider, concurrent-dispatch, and cross-Repository safety tests and align cancellation documentation
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon-tracker -p codeon -p codeoo-agent -p codeoo-agent-codex -p codeoo-agent-cursor -p codeoo-agent-grok --all-targets -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test -p codeon -p codeoo-agent -p codeoo-agent-cursor -p codeoo-agent-grok cancel`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-agent-codex --test adapter_integration mcp_runtime::`
